title: Celery Salt
description: Microwave leftover celery leaves until crisp and mix them with coarse salt for a quick and easy celery salt seasoning that adds depth to any dish.
ingredients: 0.5 cup loosely-packed celery leaves, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps.text: Line a microwave-safe plate with a paper towel. Place celery leaves in a single layer on the paper towel; cover with a second paper towel. Microwave leaves, rearranging if needed, in 30-second intervals until dry and crispy. Uncover and cool, about 10 minutes.
Measure out 2 tablespoons celery leaves and crumble with your fingers. Add to salt and mix well. Briefly pulse in a spice grinder if desired.
